_comment: Plain-language descriptions of what the agent can DO, for the skills table students read.
One entry per capability, not per workflow: 'Add a task' is one capability spread across
three workflows (propose, confirm, write), and a learner should meet it as one idea.
Write descriptions the way you would explain them out loud. No node names, no tool ids.
When you add a tool workflow, add it here too, or it stays invisible to learners.

capabilities.name: See your tasks
capabilities.description: Read the tasks saved on your computer and tell you what is open, blocked, or finished.

capabilities.name: Add a task
capabilities.description: Write down a task you describe. It always shows you the exact wording and waits for you to confirm before saving anything.

capabilities.name: Change a task's status
capabilities.description: Move a task to in progress, blocked, or done. It confirms with you first, the same way adding a task does.

capabilities.name: Research your own website
capabilities.description: Scan a website you own to build a summary of the business, who it competes with, and the words people might search for.
capabilities.needs: Your Anthropic credential, selected on workflow 50

capabilities.name: Recall what it learned about your business
capabilities.description: Look up the research it saved earlier, so you do not have to explain your business again every time.

capabilities.name: Research SEO with paid DataForSEO evidence
capabilities.description: Run authorised market-specific domain research using current rankings, organic competitors, keyword ideas, related and long-tail terms, and live search results, then save the costs, sources, warnings, and evidence for later advice.
capabilities.needs: Your Anthropic credential and an encrypted DataForSEO API Basic Auth credential

capabilities.name: Recall saved paid SEO research
capabilities.description: Read historical market-specific rankings, competitors, keyword evidence, live search results, costs, sources, and warnings without making another paid call.

capabilities.name: Find people who have a problem you solve
capabilities.description: Search YouTube comments for people describing a problem you help with, and save what they said in their own words.

capabilities.name: Find a likely professional profile
capabilities.description: Search for one named person's likely public LinkedIn profile, compare the candidates, and explain the match confidence without exposing contact data.
capabilities.needs: A Crustdata Bearer Auth credential and explicit approval for each search of up to 0.30 credits
